title: medicago coronata var. glandulosa
intro: Medicago coronata var. glandulosa, commonly known as glandular red clover, is a subspecies of red clover that is native to certain parts of Europe. It is a perennial legume plant known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of M. coronata var. glandulosa include wound healing, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, such as formononetin and biochanin A, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
